patch.summary:
Choose ADP Workforce Now only if your buying job matches “Mid-market payroll + HR (Select / Plus / Premium packaging) — custom PEPM quote; no publis” rather than Personio's shape. Choose Personio only if your buying job matches “EU mid-market HRIS — Core from €7.60 PEPM (no USD list); CorePro and Recruiting/Payroll ap” rather than ADP Workforce Now's shape. Workflow advantage: ADP Workforce Now leans payroll-benefits; Personio leans core-hris. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: ADP Workforce Now is Mid-market payroll + HR (Select / Plus / Premium packaging) — custom PEPM quote; no published seat $. Landscape vs Gusto.; Personio is EU mid-market HRIS — Core from €7.60 PEPM (no USD list); CorePro and Recruiting/Payroll apps are quote-led; 12-month annual minimum..
- Workflow coverage skew: ADP Workforce Now-leaning payroll-benefits vs Personio-leaning core-hris.
- Researched limits: ADP Workforce Now — No published PEPM — invoices can include garnishment/W-2 extras; Personio — No USD list price — Core floor is EUR; Apps and CorePro are quotes.

Limitations — ADP Workforce Now: No published PEPM — invoices can include garnishment/W-2 extras; Time, talent, and benefits depth live on Plus/Premium or add-ons; Personio: No USD list price — Core floor is EUR; Apps and CorePro are quotes; Recruiting and full payroll are Apps, not Core.

Poor-fit cases: ADP Workforce Now is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published PEPM — invoices can include garnishment/W-2 extras · Personio is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No USD list price — Core floor is EUR; Apps and CorePro are quotes · Avoid ADP Workforce Now if you actually need Personio's motion (EU mid-market HRIS — Core from €7.60 PEPM (no USD list); CorePro and Recruiting/)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
